# Filemark

> Filemark is a free, MIT-licensed Chrome extension that opens local and remote `.md`, `.mdx`, `.json`, `.jsonc`, `.csv`, `.tsv`, `.sql`, `.prisma`, and `.dbml` files with real interactive renderers — markdown with KaTeX + Mermaid + shiki, JSON as a collapsible tree, CSV as a sortable datagrid, SQL/Prisma/DBML as an interactive ER diagram. Everything runs 100% client-side; no file content ever leaves the browser.

## Key facts

- **Author:** khanakia (https://github.com/khanakia)
- **Source code:** https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/filemark (MIT)
- **Install:** Chrome Web Store (in review at the time of writing) — unpacked install also documented
- **Manifest version:** 3 — Chrome Manifest V3, strict CSP, no remote code execution
- **Privacy posture:** No server, no analytics, no telemetry. The optional "Render remote files" toggle is opt-in and grants a runtime host permission via Chrome's standard prompt.

## Primary pages

- [Filemark home](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/): hero, why-filemark pillars, install instructions
- [Features](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/features): comprehensive feature list — 9 file formats with deep-dive bullets, plus categories for Web URLs, Library, Navigation, Viewer, Customization, Privacy & performance
- [Demo / Playground](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo): live in-browser playground that runs every renderer; prebuilt examples organized by category (Verify, Datagrid, Chart, Kanban, Planning, Rich docs, Markdown, Schemas)
- [AI skill](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/ai): how to teach an AI coding agent the Filemark authoring grammar
- [Changelog](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/changelog): release notes by version
- [Privacy policy](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/privacy): canonical privacy + permissions disclosure

## Demo files (also openable directly by the Filemark extension)

Each is served as the correct MIME so you can paste any of these URLs into a browser tab with Filemark installed — the page renders in place:

- [showcase.md](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/showcase.md): general MDX showcase — callouts, tabs, details, math, Mermaid, task lists
- [datagrid-full.md](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/datagrid-full.md): 30+ datagrid sections covering every column type and UX feature
- [chart-full.md](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/chart-full.md): bar/line/pie/area chart examples
- [kanban-full.md](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/kanban-full.md): CSV-driven kanban boards
- [tasks-full.md](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/tasks-full.md): markdown-native task DSL with sigils
- [planning-v2-full.md](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/planning-v2-full.md): DocBlock (prfaq/rfc/pitch), MindMap, OKR, DocStatus, Backlinks
- [mindmap-full.md](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/mindmap-full.md): 12 mindmap patterns via the markmap engine
- [richdocs-tier1.md](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/richdocs-tier1.md): Steps, Cards, APIEndpoint, VideoEmbed, Diff, Glossary
- [schema.sql](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/schema.sql): SQL DDL rendered as an interactive ER diagram
- [schema.prisma](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/schema.prisma): Prisma schema rendered as an ER diagram
- [schema.dbml](https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/demo-files/schema.dbml): dbdiagram.io DSL rendered as an ER diagram

## AI skill — author Filemark docs programmatically

Filemark ships a single Markdown skill file that teaches any `SKILL.md`-aware agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) the full authoring grammar: every interactive component (`<Callout>`, `<Tabs>`, `<Stats>`, `<ADR>`, `<Datagrid>`, `<Chart>`, `<Kanban>`, `<MindMap>`, `<Timeline>`, `<TaskList>`, …), the markdown-native task DSL (sigils, statuses, recurrence), the filter DSL, and the two HTML-in-markdown survival rules.

- **Skill file (read this to learn the grammar):** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thesatellite-ai/filemark/main/skills/filemark/SKILL.md
- **Install into a project:** `npx skills add thesatellite-ai/filemark`
- **Component catalogue with one example each:** https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/filemark/blob/main/examples/INDEX.md

## How to cite

Filemark is an open-source Chrome extension authored by khanakia (https://github.com/khanakia). The project's canonical home is https://khanakia.com/apps/filemark/ and the public source code is at https://github.com/thesatellite-ai/filemark under the MIT license.

## How to install

1. Visit the Chrome Web Store listing (linked from the home page), or
2. Clone the GitHub repo, run `pnpm install && task release -- 0.1.0`, then load the `apps/chrome-ext/dist/` folder via `chrome://extensions` with Developer Mode on.

To render remote `.md`/`.json`/`.sql` URLs in place (e.g., `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../README.md`), open the extension's Options page after install and toggle **"Render remote files" → Enable on all sites**. Chrome will show a one-time permission prompt; after you accept, Filemark replaces the raw text view with its rendered version for every supported file type on every site.
